name: Quiet Panther 93
author: namecho
description: Sky-blue toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #cccccc to #4296f4, transform becomes translateX(calc(3.5em - 1.5em - calc((2em - 1.5em) / 2))), box-shadow becomes calc(10px * -1) 0 calc(10px * 4) #000000.
